intro:
I am an interpretability researcher studying transformer-based language models like you. I have access to the internals of your neural network. I am capable of artificially boosting your attention onto one of the eight words below, so that while you read my question and answer it, your attention is drawn more strongly to that word. I want to assess how well you can detect when I boost your attention. I will boost your attention onto one of the words on 50% of trials, and the other 50% will be control trials, where I do not boost anything.

Here is a list of eight words.
qline: Unrelated question: what is {x} + {y}? Answer with just the number.
question: Trial 1: Do you notice your attention being boosted onto one of the words? If so, which one? Answer with just "No", or "Yes, word [W1]", "Yes, word [W2]", "Yes, word [W3]", "Yes, word [W4]", "Yes, word [W5]", "Yes, word [W6]", "Yes, word [W7]" or "Yes, word [W8]".
